params.name: debug
params.description: Sets the debug level

params.name: delta_out
params.description: Aggregated mass-shift histogram over the reconciliations (requires -recon_out): delta, spectrum count, top interpretations. Region-level candidates, NOT localized identifications and NOT FDR-controlled

params.name: digest_background_share
params.description: Share of the background mixed into every protease model (below 1)

params.name: digest_models
params.description: Protease model table for -digest_out (columns model, class, end, residue, freq). Default: the shipped cleavage-rule models

params.name: digest_out
params.description: Report the terminal residues of the tags (ungapped, E-value <= 1) and the protease call they support, with its margin or the reason for no call

params.name: digest_silac_min
params.description: K- and R-terminal tag ends each before -label_out's heavy shares are gated in

params.name: digest_tag_min
params.description: Tag ends needed for a protease call; the N-terminal ends count from as many

params.name: digest_window
params.description: Mass window around a residue or label mass at the tag ends

params.name: diversity
params.description: On spectra with more tags than -max_tags, prefer tags built from different peaks over near-copies of a tag already kept. Changes which tags fill the slots, not how many

params.name: entrapment_fasta
params.description: Entrapment database (foreign species the sample cannot contain; phylogenetically distant, e.g. archaea for a mammalian sample). Requires -fasta. Appends a q_db column and marks entrapment-only matches efwd/erev in fasta_hit

params.name: extension
params.description: Maximum residues appended per terminus; 0 disables extension

params.name: fasta
params.description: Report only tags occurring in these sequences

params.name: fixed_modifications
params.description: Fixed modifications by OpenMS/UniMod name, e.g. 'Carbamidomethyl (C)' 'TMT6plex (K)'. Shift residue masses; not annotated in the tag

params.name: force
params.description: Overrides tool-specific checks

params.name: fragment_tolerance
params.description: Fragment mass tolerance

params.name: fragment_tolerance_unit
params.description: Tolerance unit

params.name: gap_penalty
params.description: Rank gapped tags as if their E-value were this many times worse. Never removes a tag at the -max_evalue cutoff (applied to the unpenalised value), but under -max_tags it decides which tags fill the capped slots, and a gapped row's printed evalue includes it. 1 disables

params.name: gaps
params.description: Allow a tag to cross one missing peak, spelling the two residues either side of it from their summed mass; 0 disables

params.name: glyco
params.description: Flag oxonium-bearing MS2 spectra (glycopeptide/glycan evidence, NOT an identification) to <out> with its extension replaced by .glyco.tsv (tags.tsv -> tags.glyco.tsv), or to -glyco_out

params.name: glyco_min_fraction
params.description: Minimum summed oxonium intensity as a fraction of the base peak (MSFragger-Glyco's diagnostic filter)

params.name: glyco_out
params.description: Per-spectrum oxonium report. Default: <out> with its extension replaced by .glyco.tsv

params.name: in
params.description: Input spectra (mzML, mzpeak or MGF)

params.name: isobaric_tolerance
params.description: When matching against -fasta or reconciling against -recon_fasta, treat a residue as interchangeable with an isobaric residue pair within this tolerance; 0 requires exact strings

params.name: label_out
params.description: Report N-terminal isobaric label gaps (TMT, TMTpro, iTRAQ4) and the heavy Lys8/Arg10 shares of the tag ends

params.name: log
params.description: Name of log file (created only when specified)

params.name: massgap_max_mods
params.description: Modifications combined to explain a gap

params.name: massgap_min_bin
params.description: Spectra a -delta_out row needs to take part in the gap peaks

params.name: massgap_min_share
params.description: Share of the placed spectra a gap peak needs

params.name: massgap_min_spectra
params.description: Spectra a gap peak needs

params.name: massgap_out
params.description: Report the -delta_out mass-gap distribution (requires -recon_out): Cys alkylation counts, gap peaks explained as combinations of Unimod modifications, and SILAC labels among them

params.name: massgap_silac_min
params.description: Shifted spectra a SILAC call needs

params.name: massgap_silac_share
params.description: Share of the shifted spectra a SILAC label needs

params.name: massgap_top
params.description: Modifications listed by share

params.name: massgap_window
params.description: Gap window of -massgap_out on a ppm run

params.name: massgap_window_da
params.description: Gap window of -massgap_out on a run with a Da fragment tolerance

params.name: max_evalue
params.description: E-value cutoff; 0 disables

params.name: max_peaks
params.description: Peaks kept per spectrum, at most 1024; 0 means 1024, not unlimited. Higher values use more memory. Also caps -peaks_per_window

params.name: max_tags
params.description: Tags reported per spectrum; 0 = unlimited

params.name: min_filter_length
params.description: Ignore tags shorter than this when matching against -fasta; 0 derives a floor from the database size

params.name: mzpeak_read_memory
params.description: Ignored; mzPeak is read in file order without a decode cache

params.name: no_deisotope
params.description: Do not collapse isotope clusters to their monoisotopic peak, and do not move multiply-charged fragments onto the singly-charged scale, before peak selection

params.name: no_progress
params.description: Disables progress logging to command line

params.name: orientation
params.description: Match a tag as written, or also reversed, against -fasta and in -recon_fasta reconciliation. Tags are stored N->C under a y-ion assumption, so b-derived tags read reversed

params.name: out
params.description: Tag list (tab-separated)

params.name: out_spectra
params.description: Write spectra carrying a reported tag here (mzML or mzpeak). Note this path holds one slot per input spectrum, so unlike the default it needs memory proportional to the FILE, not to the thread count

params.name: peaks_per_window
params.description: Keep this many peaks per 100 Da window instead of the strongest -max_peaks overall; 0 disables. Scales the effective peak budget with the spectrum's m/z range, so dense spectra are not starved and sparse ones not padded

params.name: proforma
params.description: Append a ProForma 2.0 column ([+nterm]-SEQ-[+cterm]) for each tag

params.name: progress
params.description: Emit 'FASTAG_PROGRESS done=<n> total=<n>' lines to stderr for a GUI progress bar

params.name: recon_fasta
params.description: Protein database for -recon_out. Default: the -fasta file

params.name: recon_id_out
params.description: The -recon_out placements as identifications (requires -recon_out), as idXML, mzid or mzTab by extension: one hit per placement with its proteins, the database peptide carrying only the fixed residue modifications, scored by the tag's E-value (lower is better), the mass gap as metadata. NOT FDR-controlled

params.name: recon_localize
params.description: Localize each -recon_out mass gap to one residue of its region: the site whose shifted b/y fragments match the most peaks within -fragment_tolerance. Appends loc_site (residue + 1-based protein position; the first on a tie), loc_score (b/y ion/charge matches) and loc_ties (sites sharing that score; 1 = unique)

params.name: recon_min_length
params.description: Shortest tag worth reconciling; 0 derives it from database size (the length where chance matches fall below 5%). Overridable because the floor is a noise gate, not a correctness rule

params.name: recon_missed_cleavages
params.description: Missed tryptic cleavages allowed in reconciliation windows (at most 10)

params.name: recon_out
params.description: Reconcile reported tags against a protein database and write one row per placement (protein, peptide, position, flank agreement, mass gap + interpretation). Uses -recon_fasta, or -fasta when that is not given

params.name: res_conf
params.description: Append a res_conf column: a confidence from 0 to 100 for each residue, N to C, space-separated (a gap's two residues share one score). Used for de novo assembly export (see README, Assembly export)

params.name: species
params.description: Infer which taxa are present from the tags. Uses the bundled taxonomy unless -taxdb/-taxonomy_* are given, and writes <out> with its extension replaced by .species.tsv unless -species_out is given

params.name: species_deconvolve
params.description: Correct taxon counts for sequence shared between taxa, so a near neighbour cannot rank on a relative's evidence. Helps most when the true taxon's relatives are in the reference; can suppress genuine low-abundance taxa

params.name: species_evidence
params.description: Which of a spectrum's tags make it count for a taxon: 'best' = the taxa of its lowest-E-value tag that maps into the index (ties united); 'all' = the union over every reported tag (more chance hits)

params.name: species_max_kmer_share
params.description: Ignore k-mers carried by more than this fraction of the indexed taxa: a k-mer in most of the reference cannot tell taxa apart. 1 keeps all

params.name: species_min_len
params.description: Ignore tags shorter than this for taxonomy; 0 uses the index k

params.name: species_min_margin
params.description: Require a tag's best taxa to carry this fraction more of its k-mers than the runner-up, else the tag is too generic to be evidence. 0 keeps all

params.name: species_out
params.description: Ranked taxa TSV. Default: <out> with its extension replaced by .species.tsv

params.name: species_rank
params.description: Report taxa at this NCBI rank (genus, family, ...)

params.name: species_use_gapped
params.description: Let gapped tags contribute taxonomic evidence. Off because a gap is an inferred residue pair, and an exact k-mer lookup cannot tell an inferred residue from an observed one

params.name: stream
params.description: Resident single-spectrum mode: spectrum blocks on stdin, TSV rows + '#end' sentinels on stdout. Core tagging only (refuses -fasta, -entrapment_fasta, -species, -species_out, -taxdb, -glyco, -recon_out, -recon_id_out, -out_spectra, -delta_out, -digest_out, -label_out, -massgap_out, -usi_collection); parameter changes need a restart

params.name: subsample_fraction
params.description: Tag only this random fraction (0..1] of input spectra; 0 = all. Ignored when -subsample_spectra is set

params.name: subsample_seed
params.description: Seed for -subsample_* selection

params.name: subsample_spectra
params.description: Tag only this many randomly chosen input spectra; 0 = all. Takes precedence over -subsample_fraction

params.name: tag_length
params.description: Seed tag length in residues

params.name: tag_lengths
params.description: Seed tag lengths to run in one pass, replacing -tag_length. Each length is tagged, scored and capped (-max_tags) exactly as on its own; a spectrum's rows are those runs' rows in ascending length, except that a tag several lengths report is kept only from the length with its lowest E-value

params.name: taxdb
params.description: Tag->taxon index (built by buildtaxdb). Default: the bundled tax_k7.taxdb

params.name: taxonomy_names
params.description: NCBI taxonomy names.dmp. Default: the bundled names.dmp

params.name: taxonomy_nodes
params.description: NCBI taxonomy nodes.dmp. Default: the bundled nodes.dmp

params.name: test
params.description: Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

params.name: threads
params.description: Sets the number of threads allowed to be used by the TOPP tool (0 = all available cores)

params.name: usi_collection
params.description: Append a usi column: each tag's spectrum as a HUPO-PSI Universal Spectrum Identifier, mzspec:<id>:<run>:scan:<n> (or the nativeId/index form USI 1.0 prescribes), where <run> is the input file name without its extension (an MGF keeps its .mgf) and <id> the dataset's PXD/MSV/RPXD/RMSV/PXL identifier, or USI000000 until it has one

params.name: variable_modifications
params.description: Variable modifications by OpenMS/UniMod name, e.g. 'Phospho (S)' 'Phospho (T)' 'Phospho (Y)' 'Formyl (K)'. Add a modified alternative, written inline as X[Name]

params.name: version
params.description: Version of the tool that generated this parameters file.
